# Western Toilet Map

> Western Toilet Map helps foreign travelers in China quickly find nearby clean Western-style (seated) toilets, with verified locations, walking time, and one-tap navigation.

Western Toilet Map is a mobile-first web app designed as a calm "safety button" for travelers caught short. Tap once to scan nearby China-local toilet candidates and get a sorted list of likely Western toilets - malls, hotel lobbies, transport hubs, premium cafes, and traveler-friendly venues - with distance, navigation, and amenity tags. One free emergency search is included; unlimited searches are available via a low-cost Travel Pass (7 days, 14 days, or lifetime), delivered as a private magic link with no account required.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Tap to find verified Western toilets within 1 km, sorted by walking distance.
- [Toilet Finder China](/toilet-finder-china): Main English page for visitors looking for a toilet finder in China.
- [Toilets in China](/toilets-in-china): Practical guide to public toilets, squat toilets, seated toilets, toilet paper, hygiene, and navigation choices in China.
- [Western Toilets in China](/western-toilet-china): Guide to finding Western-style seated toilets while traveling in China.
- [Squat Toilets in China](/squat-toilets-china): Visitor guide explaining squat toilet expectations and fallback options.
- [China Bathroom Tips](/china-bathroom-tips): Practical bathroom-preparation tips for foreign travelers in China.
- [Bathroom App China](/bathroom-app-china): Web-app positioning page for travelers searching for bathroom apps in China.
- [China Public Toilet App](/china-public-toilet-app): Public-toilet app page focused on live nearby discovery and navigation.
- [Press & Partners](/press): Official product description, suggested anchor text, and link targets for travel writers and partners.
